# Annotations record UTF-16 spans and never change the text; emitLineOnce
# only deduplicates single-part lines (strings by value, names by identity);
# gathered source keeps its items.
input json TopLevel {"a": [1, 2], "b": {"c": "x"}}

render probe {} script
line ["x", {"ann": "inline", "s": ["😀", {"top": "TopLevel"}]}, "y"]
annotate "block"
line ["one"]
indented
line ["two"]
end
end
line ["after"]
annotate "empty"
end
line ["z"]
end

render probe {} script
lineonce ["//"]
lineonce ["//"]
line ["//"]
lineonce ["//"]
lineonce ["a", "b"]
lineonce ["a", "b"]
lineonce [{"top": "TopLevel"}]
lineonce [{"top": "TopLevel"}]
lineonce [["//"]]
lineonce []
item "x"
lineonce ["x"]
line []
line [["import \"fmt\""]]
lineonce ["import \"fmt\""]
lineonce ["import \"fmt\""]
item ["y"]
line []
lineonce ["y"]
lineonce [["y"]]
end

render probe {} script
line ["start"]
blank 1
gathertwice
blank 2
line ["gathered"]
indented
line ["inside"]
end
blank 1
end
line ["end"]
end

render probe {} script
line ["names"]
line [{"type": 0}, " ", {"prop": [0, "a"]}, " ", {"prop": [0, "b"]}]
tostring ["a\nb", {"top": "TopLevel"}]
tostring {"mod": "wrap", "s": {"mod": "upper", "s": {"top": "TopLevel"}}}
end
